scope: scripts/capture_typed_routes_owned.py: the 13 inputs of route-capture-scoped-packet.v1.json in one owned TIA V21 project retrieved from the SHA-bound software-unit baseline: software-unit and alternate-namespace instance-effect pairs (callee template, FB and instance DB with RetainedMarker 42, then the FB redeclared with a Child multi-instance while the dependent DB was observed), a unit tag table, namespace-qualified global operand DBs and LAD/FBD callers reading and writing a namespaced DB member in both routes. Every input compiled clean and saved; only declared additions, the declared redeclarations and their observed dependent DBs changed; the saved state matched a fresh-process reopen. The extracted route effect pairs keep the complete existing DB payload and append only Child.
limitations: Native reference capture only; enabling route createMulti and global DB operand profiles needs builder qualification.

Unit tag operands are excluded: an earlier capture of the same packet (artifacts/cap-scoped, sha256 164b76ea...) compiled an M-memory unit tag caller with 'Accessing this type of tag is not possible in software units'; %I/%Q unit tags are unobserved.
